mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a significant contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 YoY < -2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in UNRATE above 4% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 4% for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PAYEMS and a fall in UNRATE indicates a broad-based increase in employment without wage inflation, which supports corporate profit margins and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO below -0.5% for four consecutive months signals weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < -0.5% for four consecutive months (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in HOUST and RSAFS above their respective 12-month moving averages signals increased housing and retail demand, which boosts consumer spending and supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 12-month moving averages (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-month decline in CPIAUCSL below 2% while FEDFUNDS remains above 4% suggests disinflation despite tight policy, which may signal a reduction in growth fears and support equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when CPIAUCSL < 2% and FEDFUNDS > 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent fall in UNRATE below 3.0% for six consecutive months signals a loosening labor market, which reduces wage growth pressure and input costs, supporting profit margins and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE < 3.0% for six consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).
